text:
carla_ae: Heads-up — Silvercrest legal just sent back their IdP/security checklist. Main asks: SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain ownership constraints, audit log retention, and CMK for keys. They also want pricing for a 2-week POC that could turn into Dedicated if it passes.

mike_se: Got it. Do they require SCIM delta sync (incremental) or just full sync on each run?

carla_ae: Quote from legal: 'SCIM delta support preferred; ability to map nested groups to RBAC roles; provisioning latency under 60s typical.' They also want SAML attr mapping (email, groups, role).

jess_re: For SAML assertions we support attribute mappings and multiple mapping rules. Example we can provide:
```
NameID: email
Attribute: groups -> mapped_to: team_role
Attribute: department -> mapped_to: product_access
```
This is standard; can add transform rules if needed.

ivan_security: Need to confirm: do they require domain verification to restrict signups to verified domains only? And what's retention on audit logs (they asked 12 months)? Also CMK (customer-managed keys) for at-rest must be supported for Private. Hosted can offer envelope encryption but not CMK by default.

emma_csm: Silvercrest prefers not to self-host unless necessary. They'll evaluate Hosted first, but CMK + 12mo logs might push them to Dedicated or Private. POC goal: validate SSO + SCIM mapping + RBAC enforcement + end-to-end provisioning with 10 test users.

mike_se: Technical notes: Hosted supports SCIM v2 with delta sync. Nested groups flattening is handled via mapping rules we can add at provisioning time. RBAC: we can map group -> role and enforce per-route/model access. Audit trails: hosted provides event logs (90 days by default), with extended retention add-on up to 13 months for enterprise plan. Private offers full retention control.

ivan_security: That's acceptable if extended retention is available as an add-on. Need proof of controls: SOC2 mention, encryption in transit (TLS1.2+), KMS integration for Dedicated/Private, and ability to export logs to their SIEM (S3 or syslog).

carla_ae: Pricing ask: they want a ballpark for a 2-week POC for ~10 users, 50k tokens/day, and then committed Dedicated starting at 4 GPUs for production. Also want to understand any setup fees for Private.

mike_se: Quick numbers: Hosted POC — free credits + paid overage; we can cover initial 2 weeks under SP if they sign NDA (we've done this before). Dedicated: baseline monthly for 4x A100-ish equivalent = $XXk/month (I'll prod finance for exact). Private: one-time setup + monthly platform fee + infra (depends on their on-prem/cloud). I'll ping finance now.

deploybot: deploy:generated-scim-test-config available at https://redwood.internal/scim-configs/silvercrest-POC (private link).

jess_re: I'll attach sample SCIM patch payload adapter we use for nested group flattening:
```
PATCH /Users/2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "replace",
    "value": {"members": ["group-a","group-b"]}
  }]
}
```
This is what our SCIM endpoint responds to during delta updates.

ivan_security: Also confirm RBAC enforcement for model access: they require a way to disable access to sensitive models for certain roles. Can we tag models and attach role allow-lists?

mike_se: Yes — model-level ACLs exist. You can tag deployments and create policies such as `allow model:compliance-* to role:biz_analyst` and deny otherwise. We can demonstrate in POC.

carla_ae: Next steps for POC timeline: 1) Send them SAML attr mapping template + sample SCIM config (done), 2) Offer 2-week hosted POC with extended log retention trial, 3) Provide dedicated pricing estimate and Private setup ballpark, 4) Get signed NDA for credits. Can we get security to send a short cover note for legal?

ivan_security: I'll draft a one-page controls summary (SOC2, TLS, encryption at rest, KMS options, log export) by EOD and include sample ATO language.

emma_csm: I'll coordinate customer test accounts and confirm domain list (they have 2 domains). Also will collect their IdP metadata file.

carla_ae: Thanks all. Mike, Ivan, Jess — can we have a quick demo w/ SCIM delta + RBAC mapping tomorrow 10am PT?

mike_se: Confirmed. Setting up demo workspace with test data.

jess_re: I'll prep the SCIM sample payloads.

ivan_security: I'll join for any compliance questions.

carla_ae: Perfect. I'll reply to Silvercrest to confirm timeline and ask them to send IdP metadata + domain verification artifacts. :thumbsup:

emma_csm: I'll also open a shared doc with acceptance criteria for POC and link it to the thread.

carla_ae: closing loop — will post the signed NDA and demo invite here once done.
